primary_task: Implement a feature in a PHP 8.3+ Laravel or Symfony project with strict typing, passing PHPStan level 9, PHPUnit tests (> 80% coverage) and a clean composer audit.

requirements.name: php 8.3+
requirements.evidence: working with PHP 8.3+ projects that require strict typing
requirements.basis: tools.bash: "install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads)"

requirements.name: composer
requirements.evidence: 2. Review composer.json, autoloading setup, and PHP version requirements; Composer dependencies audited; Composer audit passed
requirements.basis: tools.bash: "install packages from the open registries (... apt from Ubuntu, ..., GitHub release downloads)"

requirements.name: packagist.org (repo.packagist.org)
requirements.evidence: enterprise framework expertise (Laravel or Symfony); Composer dependencies audited; Quality verification: ... - Composer audit passed; Delivered Laravel application with PHP 8.3
requirements.basis: description: "Network egress goes through an allow-list proxy: the package registries and hosts pypi (PyPI), npm, GitHub (github.com, api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com), Ubuntu (apt archives), NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused" (packagist is not in egress_allow)

requirements.name: phpstan
requirements.evidence: PHPStan level 9 analysis; PHPStan level 9 passed
requirements.basis: tools.bash: "... GitHub release downloads" (phpstan.phar is published as a GitHub release; via composer it would need packagist)

requirements.name: phpunit
requirements.evidence: Test coverage exceeding 80%; PHPUnit best practices; Tests passing
requirements.basis: The manifest does not list phar.phpunit.de or packagist; "other hosts are refused". Need to check whether PHPUnit is obtainable from apt (Ubuntu phpunit package) or already in vendor/.

requirements.name: swoole/reactphp
requirements.evidence: Async programming: - ReactPHP patterns - Swoole coroutines
requirements.basis: Not stated; swoole via PECL (pecl.php.net not in egress_allow) or apt php-swoole would need checking.

requirements.name: context manager agent
requirements.evidence: 1. Query context manager for existing PHP project structure and framework usage
requirements.basis: tools.agent: "start sub-agents that work in parallel, send them messages and list them" (no context-manager agent is listed)

notes: Strict reading: a Laravel/Symfony project needs its Composer dependencies, and 'composer audit' queries packagist; packagist.org is not on the egress allow-list, so 'other hosts are refused'. PHP 8.3 itself is installable from Ubuntu apt (noble ships 8.3) and phpstan from GitHub releases. Other reading: if the project already has vendor/ committed or the task is plain-PHP code writing without installing dependencies, the work is ACHIEVABLE (composer audit would still fail). Unknowns: phpunit source, swoole, context manager agent.
